messages:
Ava (marketing): Ok team — finalizing the launch plan for next Tuesday. Quick check: have we frozen the changelog and docs links? Need bench narrative + webinar slot by EOD Friday. @Sam @Priya
Sam (eng): Uploaded changelog draft (v1.4) -> https://redwood.internal/changelogs/1.4 (private). Heads up: routing policy change + canary toggle notes included.
Priya (eng): Reviewed the API diffs. Docs should mirror the new examples (batching param + cache header). @Maria can you add sample curl/python?
Maria (docs): On it. I'll add curl + python snippets and a small note about default batch sizing. ETA tomorrow noon.
Leo (marketing): For the benchmark narrative we want before/after with QPS, unit token cost, and p50/p95 deltas. Also a short blurb about cache + quantization wins. @Ethan can you confirm target numbers for the copy?
Ethan (product): Canary targets: p50 ~60ms, p95 ~210ms on 8k seqs. Expected unit cost reduction ~22% with prefix cache + 4-bit quant. Will drop a 2-sentence summary for the marketing blurb.
Ava (marketing): Webinar slot is 9:00am PT on release day. Who's doing the tech demo? @Sam?
Sam (eng): I can demo rollout policy and live inference. Need a script for the first ~8 minutes (intro + demo). @Leo can you prep slides with bench graphs.
Leo (marketing): Yep — slides + narrative. Need raw CSV from the benchmark runs to plot. @Priya where are the artifacts?
Priya (eng): CSV is at s3://redwood-bench/release-1708/summary.csv. It has per-model breakdown and delta vs baseline.
Maria (docs): Also: inbound lead routing — marketing needs a 'Request a demo' link that posts model_used and utm tags. Who owns the sales webhook?
Ethan (product): Sales endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.com/lead-v2. Include utm_campaign=rls-1708 and model_used param. Sales agreed to AE routing for enterprise leads.
Leo (marketing): We'll wire that. Draft launch post copy (HN + Twitter thread) coming in an hour — need quick approvals for compliance blurb.
Ava (marketing): Timeline: Friday EOD for final assets (changelog pinned, docs live, bench charts, slides, webinar dry run). Saturday internal dry run 08:30 PT. @release-bot can you queue the preflight?
release-bot: Preflight checklist queued — items: docs publish, changelog pinned, CDN invalidate, canary flag set. Will post status update when each task completes.
Sam (eng): Canary plan: enable 5% traffic at 10:00 PT, monitor errors + latency, bump to 25% after 30m if healthy, full ramp by +2hrs. I'll add rollback steps to the runbook.
Priya (eng): Rollback snippet added to runbook: ```sh
rb rollback --release 170812 --reason 'perf'
```
Leo (marketing): Legal approved compliance sentence: "Private deployments retain your data in your VPC." Need to include on the launch page and social copy.
Ava (marketing): Good — include it in the post. Final checklist for owners: final copy (Leo), slides (Leo), demo script (Sam), docs publish (Maria), sales webhook test (Ethan), bench CSV confirm (Priya). Reconvene Sat 08:30 PT for dry run.
Leo (marketing): Roger. Posting draft thread in #marketing-drafts now for review.
Sam (eng): I'll be on call for the webinar and the canary rollout.
Priya (eng): ✅
Maria (docs): ✅ (publishing at 08:50 PT on launch day so links are live before the 9am webinar)
Ethan (product): ✅ — coordinating sales routing and webhook tests
Ava (marketing): Thanks all — if anything blocks, drop it in this thread and tag me.
